node.text: Being A Fifth Third Better® is not just about your performance on-court, it’s about how you push yourself to go above and beyond in all aspects of life. I learned a lot about myself as a person and a teammate while I was recovering, and I’m grateful for those lessons #team53

Wouldn’t recommend this bank, they hire bullies and when you report it they fire you and short your pay. Chandler Frutiger, Jeremiah Stotmeister, and Dave selby are all management in the north region, specifically Nashville locations who are complacent when it comes to being bullied in the work place and complaints handled reporting bullying and harassment in the workplace when it comes to protecting employees from Shawanda Childs. She is a bully who has harassed and created a hostile work environment and violated multiple workplace policies and procedures and nothing has been done about it.
@txm35  so so proud of you.  Love you buddy.
Certified Cincinnati legend in the making 🐐
